scope: Local re-encoding only, 3 dates x 1024x1024 pixels at 3 distributed locations x 2 bands per sensor, 3 pyramid levels; ingestion/network excluded. Source reads and imports excluded from encode timing; process peak RSS includes them. OS caches warm, no fsync. Quantization errors are relative to existing 0.01 dB stored values, not raw sensor powers. No visual or scientific acceptance of lossy cases.
